The overall lesson covered the main concepts of hash tables, including their definition, functionality, and applications. By the end of this lesson, students should have a solid understanding of what hash tables are and how they are used in various contexts. This lesson also highlighted the benefits of using hash tables, such as efficient lookup times, and discussed common use cases.

slides.content: A hash table uses a hash function to compute an index into an array of buckets or slots, from which the desired value can be found. Think of it like a super-fast lookup table.
